raw_sections.experience:
Experience: 12+ Years Financial Services | Investment Banking | Capital Markets
▌ EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Change & Transformation professional with 12+ years of experience across Financial Services, Investment Banking, Capital Markets and Banking Operations, with experience leading business change, adoption and transformation across complex global environments. Experienced in change impact assessment, business and market readiness, readiness governance, entry/exit criteria, stakeholder and change-network management, training and communications, adoption measurement, go-live readiness and hypercare. Proven ability to establish central change frameworks, playbooks, templates and minimum standards while coordinating local business teams, SMEs and change champions to drive consistent execution across markets. Strong experience partnering with Business, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance and senior stakeholders to manage dependencies, RAID, risks, issues and readiness sign-offs. Deep domain experience across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, FX Operations, AML/KYC, financial operations and regulatory change.
▌ CORE EXECUTIVE COMPETENCIES
Change & Adoption Strategy Business & Market Readiness • Change Impact Assessment Readiness Frameworks & Entry/Exit Criteria • Central & Local Change Governance Change Champions & SME Networks • Training & Communications Adoption Measurement
Go-Live & Hypercare Readiness Operating Model & Process Transformation • RAID, Risk & Dependency Management Stakeholder & Executive Governance • Regulatory & Control Readiness Financial Services & Capital Markets • AML/KYC & Operational Controls Transformation Governance
▌ DOMAIN EXPERTISE
Investment Banking Operations | Capital Markets | FX Operations | Financial Services Transformation | Banking Operations | Collateral & Margin Operations | Mutual Fund Operations | AML/KYC | Operational Risk & Controls | Regulatory Compliance | Client Servicing
